title: Gym Membership Comparison: Annual vs Monthly Pass
description: Comparing annual and monthly gym passes from the same gym for a 4-month usage plan with 8 visits per month, each 60 minutes long, under a budget of 1300 CNY.
originalInput: 我在比较同一家健身房的年卡和月卡。年卡1200元人民币，月卡150元人民币，两种都不限次数，服务相同且无其他费用。我计划用4个月，每月8次，每次60分钟。我首先考虑总支出，预算最多1300元。

usesPerMonth.note: Usage frequency specified as 8 times per month

budgetCents.note: Budget of 1300 CNY converted to minor units (1 CNY = 100 cents)

assumptions: No additional fees beyond the stated pass prices.
Service quality and access are identical between annual and monthly passes.
User will use the gym exactly as planned: 4 months, 8 times/month, 60 minutes/session.
